text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text:
We're doing great, Li'l Bro.
Come over here and let me give you lots of headpats!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大分倒したね、
弟くん。
偉いぞ、
お姉ちゃんがいっぱい褒めてあげる！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Right, now let's keep up the good work!
text_block_list.orig_text: この調子で次もどんどん倒していこうね！
